exposure: Improvements in antenatal care and treatment
Reduction in preterm birth before 34 weeks
cohort: Participants were all multiple pregnancies managed in a university tertiary obstetric unit in Hong Kong between 2000 and 2019.
finding: Despite an increase in the prevalence of multiple pregnancies, the total perinatal mortality rate improved by 45.4% over the 20-year study period, attributed to better antenatal care and reduced preterm birth.
followup_time: Up to late neonatal death (typically within 28 days of birth)
gest_age: Preterm birth before 34 weeks; specifically 31-33 weeks subgroup
